title: ZHU
gallery_text: This map shows that a polycentric transit framework could restructure the Los Angeles Metro into a more effective regional system by realigning transit investment with actual demand and land-use patterns.

answers.interest: I have been using GIS a lot for mapping and spatial analysis, and I am interested in taking this work further by adding layers of detail and making my maps more interactive and dynamic through simulations.
answers.suggestions: Something like a street activity sandbox would be helpful
